behavior: Unlinked Ethereum keys appear as selectable primary EVM identities; linked children remain grouped with their Substrate parent. No encrypted record migration is required.

EVM approval derives the selected primary key or public address identity, including linked public metadata. Lookup is restricted to EVM requests so Solana/Iroha addresses are not passed through a Substrate decoder.
Imported metadata cannot replace the canonical keyring address or key type submitted by the account list. Standalone Ethereum rows are excluded from Substrate authorization.
Historical signing uses required hex Substrate payloads and explicitly selected per-site EVM grants. This updates harness expectations without broadening production authority.
preservedDiagnostics: Original missing-EVM presentation/approval failures, public-address lookup failures, unrelated-chain regression and actual metadata override failures remain retained.
